name: Aegis Authenticator
tagline: Best Android 2FA app — fully open source, encrypted backups, no cloud required
highlights: Fully open source with public audit — available on F-Droid and Google Play
Encrypted local backups you can store anywhere (Dropbox, Google Drive, local)
TOTP, HOTP, and Steam tokens supported; import from Google Authenticator
verdict: The definitive Android 2FA app — open source, encrypted backups, and completely free.
bestFor: Android users who want the most transparent and secure 2FA app available

name: Raivo OTP
tagline: Best iOS 2FA app — open source, iCloud encrypted sync, Apple Watch support
highlights: Open source iOS native app with excellent design
iCloud Keychain encrypted sync across all your Apple devices
Apple Watch app for quick token access without unlocking your phone
verdict: The best iOS 2FA app — native design, iCloud sync, and fully open source.
bestFor: iOS users who want an open source app with seamless Apple ecosystem integration

name: Authy
tagline: Best multi-device sync — encrypted cloud backup and desktop app included
highlights: Encrypted cloud backup — never lose your 2FA codes if you lose your phone
Desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux in addition to iOS and Android
Multi-device sync lets you access codes on phone and computer simultaneously
verdict: Best for users who switch phones frequently or want desktop access — closed source is the tradeoff.
bestFor: Users who prioritise easy recovery and multi-device access over open source transparency

name: Google Authenticator
tagline: Simple and widely supported — Google account backup added in 2023
highlights: Google account backup added in May 2023 — previously had no backup at all
Supported by virtually every site that offers TOTP-based 2FA
No account required — works offline on iOS and Android
verdict: Adequate for most users, but Aegis (Android) or Raivo (iOS) are strictly better with no downside.
bestFor: Casual users who want the simplest possible 2FA setup with a familiar brand

name: Microsoft Authenticator
tagline: Best recovery for Microsoft account users — passwordless login and encrypted backup
highlights: Encrypted cloud backup to Microsoft account; restore to any new phone in minutes
Passwordless login for Microsoft accounts — use your phone instead of a password
Number matching feature prevents MFA fatigue attacks
verdict: Excellent if you use Microsoft 365 or Azure — solid recovery options and modern security features.
bestFor: Microsoft 365 users who want seamless integration with their work accounts
